Initial release of github-actions-clawhub-doctor.

- Diagnose why GitHub Actions to ClawHub publishes fail, with detailed layer-by-layer troubleshooting.
- Checks workflow references, owner/token secret setup, naming conflicts, pending-publication handling, and directory structure issues.
- Offers actionable, specific guidance and minimal fixes at the point of failure.
- Designed for users struggling with unclear CI errors during ClawHub publishing.
- Includes real diagnostic examples and mapping of common failures for easier troubleshooting.
- Supports macOS, requires git and clawhub CLI tools.
